'''Shadowpaw''' was a powder that remained after [[Edorian Itassi]] roots were ground up. This powder was originally used by the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] race in spiritual ceremonies via a long [[Bone/Legends|bone]] pipe, but it soon found its way in various [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and criminal dives.<ref name="SWG:Shadowpaw">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Shadowpaw}}</ref>
